title: 动森外观 · 素净画布（无插画 / 无纸纹 / 系统字体，亮暗）

assertions.message: 画布的前三个装饰层为 none，波点与斜纹底仍在
assertions.expression: (() => { const layers = getComputedStyle(document.body).backgroundImage; return layers.startsWith('none, none, none') && layers.includes('radial-gradient') && layers.includes('repeating-linear-gradient'); })()

assertions.message: 装饰与纸纹变量都被关闭
composer 保留叶片水印但移除纸纹层，对话框只剩纯色纸
assertions.expression: (() => { const composer = document.querySelector('[data-composer-card]'); const dialog = document.querySelector('[role="dialog"]'); if (!composer || !dialog) return false; return /,\s*none$/.test(getComputedStyle(composer).backgroundImage) && getComputedStyle(dialog).backgroundImage === 'none'; })()

assertions.message: 界面字体切到系统栈，组件仍能读到主题 token
assertions.expression: (() => { const family = getComputedStyle(document.body).fontFamily; return family.includes('system-ui') && family.includes('PingFang SC'); })()
